title: Quick Malaysian Almonds Stir-fry
description: Peppery, cheese-pull Malaysian dish with flaked almonds and a sweet-salty glaze, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat the comal over medium heat and add the vegetable oil.
Add the flaked almonds and stir until they start to toast lightly.
Pour in the soy sauce, honey, tamarind paste, garlic powder, chili flakes, and lime zest, then stir to coat the almonds evenly.
Cook for 3 minutes until the glaze thickens and the almonds are glossy.
Reduce heat to low and sprinkle the grated cheese over the mixture.
Cover and let the cheese melt for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally to keep the almonds from sticking.
Remove from heat and give the dish a final stir to mix the cheese throughout.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving plate and serve hot as a flavorful dinner.
If desired, garnish with a few extra chili flakes for an extra kick.
Enjoy your quick Malaysian almond stir-fry with friends or a loved one.
